title: [MAIN]-Bug 642602: Address AL1430 and remove exception from ruleset
summary: Resolved an AL1430 analyzer finding in the IN GST Stock Register for Job Work report by removing redundant sorting on Purch. Rcpt. Line, then removed the temporary AL1430 ruleset exception. No table key or schema change was needed.
key_points: Removed redundant sorting on Prod. Order No. and Prod. Order Line No. and its suppression
Both fields were already fixed by DataItemLink, so the sort had no effect
Removed the temporary AL1430 exception from the ruleset
No table key or schema change required
quote: Removed the redundant sorting and its warning suppression, then removed the temporary AL1430 ruleset exception.
